comment: A capture file: fog and mist over the fixture dungeon, for the screen test alone (D-187, D-889). The fog is a noise of three layers in one palette key, which the fog shader of Game cuts into hard bands and draws in one pass (D-897, D-898). A wide, faint sheet drifts east, a band of thicker banks drifts east faster, and thin wisps drift west. Where layers overlap, the strongest band wins (D-899). The fog draws above the figures, and its strongest band keeps each enemy of the map visible (D-885, D-886, D-892). The mist under it is a slow stream of pale motes.
